title: Ownership, moves, and copies
description: C’s ownership model: moves, clones, and when data is copied vs transferred.

> **Curriculum:** This chapter follows [LEARN-LANGUAGES/CURRICULUM.md](../../CURRICULUM.md). Exercise ids are shared across LEARN-* repos for cross-reference.

## Aliasing in C

Pointers can alias the same storage; integers copy by value. Be explicit about who owns `malloc`’d memory.

exercises.title: Move a String
exercises.description: Create `String::from("hi")`, move it into a second binding, and print the second binding only.

exercises.title: Clone to keep both
exercises.description: Create `String::from("x")`, clone into another binding, and print **both** strings concatenated (no separator): `xx`.

exercises.title: Copy integers
exercises.description: Bind `a` to `3`, copy into `b` by assignment, increment `b` by one, print `a` and `b` separated by a space.
